title: Orchestration testbed for incremental output and tool-call rerouting
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a reusable testbed that validates incremental/streamed token sequences, deterministic tool/function invocation traces, and structured-output schema fidelity across model variants and runtime configurations. Scope: streaming chunk boundaries, interleaved tool calls with partial JSON payloads, KV cache priming effects on subsequent tool routing, quantized model variants, and network-induced reordering/fallthrough. Deliverables: (1) a canonical seed set of prompts and expected token-prefix fingerprints; (2) CI jobs that run smoke + nightly exhaustive permutations against runtime-1.20 and a compatible fallback path; (3) telemetry dashboards for divergence metrics and per-model fingerprint drift; (4) remediation guide for flaky or non-deterministic regressions.
acceptance_criteria: 1) CI job 'interop/incremental-output' produces no critical regressions for the seed set across all target models in runtime-1.20 for 3 consecutive runs; 2) Structured output assertions (schema & ordering) pass for 95% of golden prompts; 3) Tool-call trace checkers detect mismatches and surface minimal repro case to GitHub issue template automatically; 4) Runbook updated with triage steps and escalation owner.
comments: 2026-02-21 - Asha Patel: Kickoff meeting notes added to Confluence. Agreed to focus first on 3 canonical workflows: (a) streaming text with embedded function/tool calls, (b) multi-tool orchestration where tool A primes KV cache for tool B, (c) structured JSON streaming with incremental schema validation.

2026-02-24 - Diego Morales: PoC harness pushed to infra repo (PR 7823). Harness supports parallel execution across model variants and emits token-level fingerprints and event traces (stream_chunk_id, tool_invocation_id, schema_assertion_id).

2026-02-26 - Lina Chen (QA): Ran initial seed set against dev-runtime. Observed 18% divergence on model-quantized-v1 for function-call ordering when sequence length exceeded 1024. Added reproducer to issue ENG-32401 and flagged as dependency.

2026-03-01 - Diego Morales: CI job 'interop/incremental-output/smoke' added to main pipeline. Gate set as non-blocking for now; will flip to blocking after two green runs. Job artifacts include ndjson traces and a minimal repro for any non-deterministic case.

2026-03-03 - Security review asked: Does incremental output expose PII via partial tool payloads? Security requested a short threat model; marked security_review_required=false for this ticket but will coordinate with Security on any customer data seeds.

2026-03-04 - Asha Patel: Decision log: We will use fingerprint similarity threshold (Levenshtein token distance normalized) and a secondary semantic check for structured outputs (JSON schema + key-order invariants where required). Trade-off: stricter fingerprint thresholds increase false positives for minor non-impactful whitespace or tokenization shifts; mitigated by classification of regressions into Acceptable/Actionable/Blocking.
